items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, I looked, I know Ashton Murray, I believe, is the same man. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Oh, I was. Did they want you to play heavy or light? Well, they'd perform heavy, but I never got a real rough piano player, you know. I must have played on the light side.
Well, I looked, I know Ashton Murray, I believe, is the same man. He's a little brown-skinned fellow.
